The centerpiece: the rehearsal tier

Until tonight the CRM surfaces had exactly one home — the live cockpit, where the CRM is Iru’s real base and a promotion CREATE is real — so the operator loop had never once been walked. server/src/airtable.ts gained an AIRTABLE_API_BASE seam (default pinned by a test), and behind it now sits a local Airtable stub serving committed fixtures. npm run test:e2e:rehearsal boots stub + server + cockpit and walks: reservoir triage → proposal → the irreversible approval → apply → the CRM actually changed, asserted against the stub’s memory, not the UI’s word. Six live-read specs whose premises live data cannot produce (a partial wave, an unrailed campaign, a blocked stage goal, pending approvals, a campaign at landing_copy, conversations) executed for the first time ever — 28 passed, 12 honest skips.

Found by the walk  Defect 9 — the proposal died on navigation. The desk’s own copy says “sign it on Approvals, then come back” — and coming back unmounted the component, losing the gate item held in React state. Step 4 returned disabled forever. No unit or route test could see it; the browser walk failed on it within minutes of existing. Fixed by re-deriving the open item from the server, with the restore guarded so a finished proposal can never re-arm from stale cache.

The walk, in pixels

Nine defects, fixed with tests

1 · PromotionDesk swallowed every server error ui change

The API layer throws on non-2xx, so the server’s reason arrived in desk.error — which the component never read. Every failure printed the same generic line. Now the server’s own words render. Veto view: screenshot above.

2 · Card and desk triaged different populations ui change

The CRM card counted the whole rail; the desk counted this campaign. Both now scope by campaign, and the card names the remainder (rail_other). Route-tested on a shared-rail fixture.

3 · “Build the queue” was enabled on any campaign ui change

One shared predicate (igDmBuildBlockReason) now gates the button server-side, with the reason on screen — a greyed option is not a guard, but an enabled one that cannot work is worse.

4 · The 25-row promotion cap was a hidden 400 ui change

The desk pre-checked everything; past PROMOTION_MAX_ROWS the first press failed with a bare zod error. Pre-selection caps at 25 with a visible “first 25 of N — promote in passes” note.

5 · cold-start failed healthy-but-empty rails spec

“Request approval for 0”, disabled, next to “Nothing clears this rail’s policy” is an answer, not the missing-button incident. The walk now accepts a rail’s own explanation — and still fails an unexplained dead control.

6 · The session break was promised, never coded ui change

IG_DM_SESSION_CEILING was plumbed to the DTO and the docs claimed it shipped; nothing counted. The desk now stops handing out rows after 10 sends per sitting, with an explicit “start a new sitting” press — the practitioner ceiling this rail is built on is per-session.

7 · Three copies of bucketLabel, plus dead exports cleanup

Desk, card and contract each hand-rolled the label map; a new bucket would silently render as its raw id. One shared function now, DTOs typed to the enum; promotableRecIds/ventureOrNull deleted; IG_DM_FEATURE literals replaced.

8 · The Airtable host was hard-coded infrastructure

AIRTABLE_API_BASE seam at four call sites, default pinned by test. This is what makes the rehearsal stack possible; the writer allow-list contract is untouched.

9 · The proposal died on navigation found by the walk

Gate item lived in component state; “come back from Approvals” unmounted it and step 4 stayed disabled forever. Re-derived from the server now, guarded against the restore-effect trap (apply removes the cache instead of invalidating).

The doctor stopped lying

crm-vocabulary ran tonight for the first time in its life. Nothing ever loaded .env into the doctor, so the check guarding the direct-CRM-write decision reported “offline” on every --live run while a real drift sat in the base — and its FIX text blamed a token scope that was never the problem. The doctor now loads .env itself and the check was widened: every value the rails declare into constrained selects (Tier, Channel, Channel_Type, the ten ICP labels in Prospects.Type) must exist as a live option — because the venture’s import path posts typecast: true, and a missing option isn’t rejected, it’s minted, permanently. Measured against the real base before a line was written: 0 false flags on 32 declared values. And north-star-writer is un-pinned: a flap quiet for 24h reads “healed, still watching” instead of staying red forever (the live-flap shape still reds — both directions tested).

The one live-read pass

100 passed · 15 failed · 10 skipped, ~9.5 minutes, read-only. All 15 failures sit in files this session never touched — acceptance (3), ads-build (4), keyword-discover (4), landing-copy (2), replies (1) — the documented pre-existing class, nearly all pinned to the killed retreats-q3 campaign. Rewriting them to derived subjects (the acceptance.spec.ts:362 pattern) was deliberately deferred: verifying a derivation needs live runs, and the night’s stack policy was isolated-only. A blind rewrite is how a net stops being a net.

One live failure WAS mine, for an hour: the rewritten partial-wave invariant executed on live for the first time and caught my own conflation of “checkbox count” with “selected count”. Fixed, re-verified on both stacks — the test now runs on live (it used to skip) and passes.
